release_gates: Run migration up/down and two-connection deletion/send concurrency on disposable PostgreSQL.
Backfill or purge legacy plaintext snapshots and recipient labels with envelope-key-aware verification.
Build and test signed iOS and Android binaries against a production-like HTTPS API.
Keep external generation and generated Jyotish disabled until provider governance and expert review pass.
Verify distributed admission control, capability-token log redaction and store privacy disclosures in deployed infrastructure.
residual_risks: The local environment has no PostgreSQL, Xcode/Simulator or Android JDK, so source and SQLite evidence cannot close those runtime gates.
The production bundle remains about 606 kB minified JavaScript; route-level code splitting is a performance follow-up, not a correctness blocker for the local MVP.
